blocks.html:
The House of sustainability is intended to be a place for education in the culture of sustainability, where students can reflect on this issue while interacting with the local area, the scientific community, and the population. A venue that will thus be able to connect various realities on the territory with the University headquarters in Lugano. The House was opened on March 21, 2024.
